howItWorks.subtitle: Booking a night by the Mediterranean is direct, paperwork-free, and without intermediaries.

connect.body: Use MetaMask or any Web3 wallet. We don't create accounts or ask for personal details.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Marina del Sol enables tokenized hotel room reservations as NFTs on Polygon network.

pilot.heading: Service nature
pilot.body: This service provides digital reservations through cryptographic tokens on blockchain.

ownership.heading: Token ownership
ownership.body: Upon booking, you receive an NFT representing the reservation in your self-custody wallet.

transfer.heading: Resale and transfer
transfer.body: You can resell your reservation in the secondary marketplace according to smart contract rules.

micaNonCustody.heading: Express Non-Custody Clause (MiCA Regulation EU 2023/1114)
micaNonCustody.body: Marina del Sol operates exclusively as decentralized self-custody software. The operator never accesses, manages, blocks, or custodies users' private keys or crypto funds. NFTs represent consumable utility rights for lodging and are not financial instruments under MiFID II nor asset-referenced tokens (ART) or e-money tokens (EMT), exempting the software from CASP licensing requirements under MiCA.

travelerRegistry.heading: Official Traveler Registry (RD 933/2021)
travelerRegistry.body: While booking and NFT transfers are pseudonymous on-chain, Spanish Royal Decree 933/2021 mandates in-person identity verification (ID/Passport) at hotel reception during physical check-in for mandatory registration in the hotel management system (PMS).

noWarranty.heading: Disclaimers
noWarranty.body: Transactions on-chain are final and irreversible. Always verify details before signing.

terms.placeholderNote: Standard terms for digital room pass reservations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: We adhere to data minimization principles under GDPR.

noPii.heading: No personal data required for booking

onChain.body: Transactions and wallet addresses are public on the Polygon network.

wallet.heading: Wallet connection

company.title: A small hotel on the seafront in Alicante
company.lead: Fifty rooms on two floors, a short walk from the beach. We sell direct: no middlemen, no portal commissions and the service of a small hotel.

story.title: How we work
story.body: In high season the hotel fills up and the rest of the year leaves nights free. Instead of leaving them empty, we sell them as nights you own: whoever buys a night can use it, gift it or resell it on this same website. We take a percentage every time a night changes hands.

direct.title: Direct
direct.body: Bookings on our own website, with no middleman taking a commission.

privacy.title: No paperwork
privacy.body: We do not ask for ID, phone or email to buy. The travellers' register is still kept at the front desk.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.body: The sales history is public: anyone can see which night sold and for how much.

local.title: Close by
local.body: A 50-room hotel: we all know each other and the service is neighbourly.

cta.title: Would you like to see the available nights?
cta.body: The catalogue shows every free night with its date, its room and its price.

facilities.title: How the hotel is laid out
facilities.lead: Two floors, 50 rooms and shared areas designed for resting.

floors.title: Floors and numbering
floors.body: The number follows the floor: 1XX rooms are on the ground floor and 2XX on the first floor. All of them have the same fittings; size and layout change.

common.title: Shared areas
common.breakfast: Breakfast room with a Mediterranean buffet.
common.pool: Outdoor pool with sun loungers and shade.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: This website meets WCAG 2.1 AA: verified contrast, keyboard navigation, visible focus and content in three languages. The reception and staff screens are designed to be used standing up and on a phone.

rooms.title: Features by room type
rooms.body: Each type has its own size and capacity. The detail, with photographs and real hotel data, is on the rooms page.
